Subject: A dark emperor seated on a colossal floating throne, viewed from a high overhead angle that emphasizes his solitude and dominance against the incomprehensible scale of the black hole below. The throne floats at the exact tipping point of the event horizon — a tiny figure in absolute command of cosmic destruction. Clothing: black robes spread dramatically outward from the throne seat, dissolving into dark smoke that curls into the gravitational pull below. The robe dissolution creates a visual wing-like silhouette when seen from above, giving the emperor a dark angelic geometry. Crown: the crown's golden light projects upward toward the camera, blazing directly at the viewer — a concentrated point of warm radiance against the darkness. Throne: the massive obsidian throne becomes a centerpiece in the circular composition, its edges catching accretion disk {argument name="lighting" default="amber"} light, casting long shadows outward in all directions. Background: radiating outward from the throne in a circle: shattered planets at various stages of destruction — some still partially intact with visible surface geography and cloud cover, others reduced to orbiting fragments and glowing magma trails. The black hole's accretion disk forms an enormous ring of fire that fills the extreme background, gravitational lensing creating concentric arcs of bent starlight around the void. The depth of the black hole stretches downward into absolute darkness below the throne. Primary Light: accretion disk light radiating inward from all sides — warm amber-gold casting circular light patterns on the throne and robe spread. Secondary Light: crown's golden upward blaze creating a spotlight-like cone toward the viewer. Ambient: cold blue-white starlight and gravitational lens arcs creating fine rim highlights on planet fragments. Color Grade: radial color — warm gold and amber at the edges from the accretion disk, deep cold black at the void center | crown warm gold beacon | robe smoke dark violet-black. Textures: detailed planetary surface geography on planet fragments, hyper-detailed robe fabric spread, rough throne stone surface with glinting mineral inclusions.
